who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane: body record holds generic MIR, served in a plan's snapshot
where: crates/blaze-keyed/src/front.rs (GivenBody.record: &'a [u8]), crates/blaze-host/src/workers.rs (Job.bodies: Vec<(StableId, Aligned, ContentId)>), crates/blaze-front/src/body/mir.rs (given), crates/hir-ty/src/store_registry.rs
what: A plan task is handed each body record as borrowed bytes, but the item store of the plan's snapshot lives in a 'static registry whose unlinked stores are freed after a reclaim grace, so it cannot hold the borrow: in-flight readers may touch a store after its guard drops. The adapter from GivenBody to the store copies each record once into an aligned holder.
cost: one copy of up to BODIES_MOST records per plan run, against a floor of none
cause: the host owns each record as a plain Aligned and lends its bytes; the store needs a counted holder
whys: the host reads each record into an Aligned of its own (Job.bodies); GivenBody was shaped for a borrow; the store's registry is lock-free with limbo reclamation, so a borrowed store would need a grace wait at the end of the plan task
class: a borrow handed across a boundary into a structure that outlives any borrow
prevention: the host keeps each record in an Arc<Aligned> and GivenBody carries it (or a &Arc<Aligned>) beside its bytes; blaze_front::body::mir::given then clones it by count
